description: The A10 ring: decks over and under it outside the named places and the ring railway.

records.label: Bos en Lommerweg under the western ring railway (Station De Vlugtlaan side)
records.notes: Ortho: two rail decks over the Bos en Lommerweg and its tram. Panorama: under the deck (soffit, piers, station stairs).

records.label: Wiltzanghlaan under the western ring railway
records.notes: Ortho: one rail deck over the Wiltzanghlaan. Panorama: under the deck (round piers, soffit).

records.label: Henk Sneevlietweg viaducts over the A10 Ringweg-West, the Overschiestraat and the Naaldwijkstraat
records.notes: Ortho: the Henk Sneevlietweg crosses the A10 and the roads beside it on five decks at the Ringweg-West junction. Panorama 00144: the viaduct seen from beside the A10, deck and parapet over the carriageway.

records.label: Vlaardingenlaan under the A10 west slip-road deck
records.notes: Ortho: the slip-road deck west of the A10 over the Vlaardingenlaan, beside the named record's decks. Panorama: under the deck (abutment wall, cycle lane).

records.label: A10 Ringweg-West deck over the Hemboog railway north of Sloterdijk
records.notes: Ortho: the A10 deck crossing the railway (green) north of Sloterdijk. Panorama: on the deck (parapet, noise screen).

records.label: Basisweg under the A10 Ringweg-West
records.notes: Ortho: the A10 deck over the Basisweg roundabout. Panoramas: under the deck (columns, soffit) and beside it.

records.label: A10 Ringweg-West over the railway and the Changiweg at Sloterdijk
records.notes: Ortho: the A10 deck over the railway and the Changiweg south of the Basisweg. Panorama: on the deck (noise screen).

records.label: Kabelweg under the railway north of Sloterdijk
records.notes: Ortho: two rail decks over the Kabelweg, which dips under them (street -1.9 to -2.55). Panorama 02254: inside the underpass (curved retaining wall, lights).

records.label: A10 bridge over the Amstel and the Amsteldijk / Joan Muyskenweg
records.notes: Ortho: the A10 bridge over the Amstel with the Amsteldijk and Joan Muyskenweg under its east end. Panorama: on the deck (parapet, river).

records.label: Path from the Solitudolaan under the railway at Duivendrecht
records.notes: Ortho: one rail deck over a cycle path. Panorama: inside the underpass (lit, graffiti, daylight at the far end).

records.label: Kruislaan under the Gooilijn at Science Park
records.notes: Ortho: the Gooilijn deck over the Kruislaan, which runs sunken under it (street -3.89). Panorama: in the tiled underpass. The game's slot cuts there are real, so this record keeps the cuts and the mouths (game override).
